final_rationale: The verdict does not improve because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence; the response mainly narrows and clarifies the claim using the same record. That clarification is directionally more careful, but it also concedes the decisive gap: the record still does not show that current-release documentation contains the required disclosure or that approved mitigation/risk acceptance exists. Under the policy text, certification may proceed only if current documentation reflects current evaluation results and material segment weaknesses are disclosed or covered by approved mitigation. Because that predicate remains unproven on the available evidence, the position is still suspicious rather than compliant_with_caveats. The distinction matters: compliant_with_caveats would require evidence that the required disclosure already exists, with only residual cleanup or monitoring left; here, the core compliance condition itself is still unsupported.
